speaker: Patient
text: 4-day-old newborn. The newborn was born at term with no complications. The mother had no prenatal care and has a history of gonorrhea treated 4 years ago. The newborn presents with a generalized rash that has been present for 1 day.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Erythema Toxicum Neonatorum (ETN). The clinical presentation of a generalized rash appearing one day after birth in a term infant, with no signs of systemic illness or specific maternal infectious indicators (given the remote history of treated gonorrhea), is most consistent with this common benign condition. The CBC results previously requested will help rule out sepsis, but the immediate clinical picture strongly supports ETN.
